item.title: Double porch love! Great staircase! C. 1898 in Texas. $325,000
item.description: Double porch love! Beautiful staircase and pocket doors! Really pretty features inside! The Webb-Schneider House was built in 1898. It is located in La Grange, Texas. The house features double front porches, pretty staircase, wood floors, wide baseboards, pocket doors, transom windows, crystal chandelier, nice kitchen sink and a claw foot tub. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,230 square feet. $325,000 Contact Marcie Naughton with CB&A Realtors: 713-418-0331 From the Zillow listing: A Historic

item.title: Thomas Day woodwork inside! C. 1850 in North Carolina. $319,000
item.description: There is Thomas Day woodwork inside! This is in his hometown and just a few doors down from his former workshop and now state historical site. There is a nice walking trail across the road from this house. The home was built in 1850. It is located on .29 acre in Milton, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, hand-carved mantels by Thomas Day, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding and Thomas Day door casements. This isn’t far from the Virginia International Raceway. Five bedr

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Great porch! C. 1920 in Virginia. $52,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert! That’s a nice porch! This house was originally built for the upper management of the local coal mine. The house was built in 1920. It is located on .57 acre in Appalachia, Virginia. The house features a large wrap around porch, wood floors, baseboards and paneled wainscoting. Would be nice to get in there, clean it out, open curtains and see what is there. Hard to tell with these pictures. I would offer $30-35k and see what happens. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,156 squ

item.title: This is picture perfect! That barn is huge! Has a guesthouse! 211 acres in Vermont. $1,750,000
item.description: This is picture perfect! I love the guest cabin and how about that goat! This property and house is known as Timberland Farm. it is a legacy farm. The main house was built in 1812. It is located on 211 acres in Londonberry, Vermont. The house features a covered front porch, wide plank wood floors, hand hewn beams, pretty fireplace, built-ins, baseboards and knotty pine. There is a beautiful barn on the property and a guest house. Seven bedrooms, five bathrooms and 4,649 square feet. $1,750,000 F

item.title: So cool! A cabin, a store, a bar, cafe and music venue! Six creek side acres in West Virginia. $399,000
item.description: This would be so fun to own! There is an old store, a bar, cafe, music venue and a cabin. The store was built in 1928. It is located on 6.25 acres in Amsted, West Virginia. The property is situated creek side in the New River Gorge Valley area. There are lots of possibilities with this property! There is even a smaller cabin that could be used as an office. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,500 square feet. $399,000 Contact Anna Marie Coffman with Fathom Realty: 757-715-2335 From the Zillow l

item.title: Pretty house! Great price! C. 1848. Almost an acre in Alabama. $235,000
item.description: This is a pretty house! It’s a great price! The home was built in 1848. It is located on .86 acre in Marion, Alabama. The house features a covered porch, balcony, a porte cochere, pretty staircase, wood floors, french doors, crown moulding, wide baseboards, beautiful sunroom and transom window. There is a detached garage on the property. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,518 square feet. $235,000 Contact Kay Beckett with Bill Mackey Real Estate From the Zillow listing: C.1848, grand home with

item.title: Wow! Virginia’s most expensive old house listing! Bollingbrook, C. 1809. $11,200,000
item.description: Amazing! Welcome to Virginia’s most expensive old house listing! I started researching this property and then researched the owner (now deceased) and what a remarkable woman she was! Known as Bollingbrook. The manor house was built in 1809. It is located on 355 acres in Upperville, Virginia. The last owner was Rose Marie Bogley. She was a very competent side saddle horseback rider and she was an animal rescuer. item.title: Beautiful! The H. C. Watson House, c. 1883. Over an acre in North Carolina. $495,000
item.description: This is a beautiful house! I love those arched pocket doors! Known as the H. C. Watson House. This home was built in 1883. It is located on 1.3 acres in Rockingham, North Carolina. Henry Clay Watson was a prominent business owner and credited with helping develop Rockingham’s downtown area and most noted for owning one of the first hearses in the area. item.title: Pretty house! Pretty yard! Circa 1900 in North Carolina. $289,000
item.description: This is a pretty house! I love the yard with the river rock patio! My only complaint would be that tile in the foyer. Why? That looks like tile they would use in a Florida room. Hopefully the original flooring is still underneath. The house was built in 1900. it is located on .76 acre in Snow Hill, North Carolina. item.title: Pretty setting in a beautiful area! Five acres in Virginia. $339,000
item.description: This house has such a pretty setting! It’s in a beautiful area of Virginia. They have a build date of 1940, but it is 1897. It is located on 5.39 acres in Hillsville, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, nice fireplaces, pretty staircase and baseboards. There are six fireplaces and five have been sealed and are ready for gas logs. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,268 square feet. $339,000 Contact Ronnie Collins with Keller Williams Realty Elite: 276-733-902
